issues.description: Mismatch in the signature of Rideable.messageOnRide(): the problem statement UML and textual description (problem_statement.md) and the template Main example expect a parameterless method messageOnRide() returning a String (with the return value format "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"). The solution repository defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) and implements Pig and Seal with messageOnRide(int speed) (including speed in the returned string). The template's Main calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments. This parameter-list mismatch will cause compilation errors for students following the problem statement/template and makes it unclear which signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable API consistent across all artifacts. Recommended (keeps the exercise text/template as-is): change the solution to declare Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters returning String, and update Pig and Seal to implement a parameterless messageOnRide() that returns exactly "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" (remove speed and its formatting). Also ensure any example calls (Main) match the parameterless signature. Alternative: if the speed parameter is intentional, update the problem_statement.md, the UML, and the template Main example to require messageOnRide(int speed) and document the expected return format that includes speed.
